fonts.note: Two hand-lettered/connected-script candidates (Caveat, Patrick Hand) and one irregular sans (Shantell Sans) were tested first and rejected: pdf-lib's simple glyph layout has no GSUB/ligature or complex GPOS support, so all three dropped or badly mis-spaced common letter pairs (e.g. Patrick Hand gapped every word containing "ll" — well, small, hello, tell). Short Stack has no such features and renders cleanly.
